objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: Every transversal $X$ of $\mathcal F$ meets $C$, since $C$ itself is a member of $\mathcal F$ whenever this assertion is applied below
objection.witness: The induction only classifies transversals meeting C. At recursive calls, C\{c} need not be a member of F_c, so a transversal of F_c may be disjoint from it; the claimed inheritance does not justify applying the induction hypothesis to all transversals.
